newsitem.title: USA: Shaman says Provir Phase IIb trials begin.
newsitem.headline: Shaman says Provir Phase IIb trials begin.

text.p: Shaman Pharmaceuticals Inc on Wednesday said it has begun patient enrollment in Phase IIb studies of Provir, an oral treatment for watery diarrhea.
This program of Phase II studies, which are double-blind, randomized and placebo controlled, is designed to obtain optimal dose information using around 700 patients.

An earlier Phase II study showed 89 percent of 75 patients treated with Provir returned to normal after 48 hours. Of the 71 patients available for follow-up, no recurrence was experienced during the post-treatment period, Shaman said.
